rules.statement: The binary pointer shall be an unsigned LPARA_PTR_W-bit value ranging 0 to 2 x depth - 1 and wrapping by design, with no extension or truncation.
The address shall be the low LPARA_ADDR_W bits of the binary pointer (0 to depth - 1), formed by truncating the MSB.
The Gray pointer shall be LPARA_PTR_W bits wide, computed as gray = bin XOR (bin >> 1), changing one bit per increment.
Gray to binary conversion shall be LPARA_PTR_W bits wide, where bit i of binary equals XOR of Gray bits i..LPARA_PTR_W-1; invalid Gray values cannot occur in the model with one-bit changes.

The occupancy estimate shall be the binary pointer difference modulo 2 x depth with explicit width cast, and shall differ from true occupancy only by pointer updates still inside the synchronizer (pessimistic).
The data word shall be an unsigned PARA_AFIFO_DATA_W-bit logic vector, bit 0 as LSB, with no interpretation, extension or truncation.
Flags shall be 1 bit wide, where 1 means the condition is true.
All hardware data shall be unsigned 4-state logic vectors, and no signed arithmetic shall be used.
